dedupe_keys.name: madrid buildings declared in legal ruin or imminent physical ruin

description: Dirección General de la Edificación, Madrid City Council publishes a quarterly list of the buildings for which a resolution has declared urban legal ruin or imminent physical ruin, giving the location, which type of ruin was declared, whether the owner failed the duty of upkeep and the month of the resolution. Coverage: the city of Madrid; the portal lists quarterly update and the record was last modified on 2026-07-23. Format and access: XLSX, PDF, downloadable without registration from the Madrid City Council open data portal (datos.madrid.es). Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0, legal code in Spanish on the portal); cost: free. Caveats: it lists declared cases only, not the condition of the wider stock, the files were not opened, and the number of years covered is unconfirmed. Simulation uses: a record of building deterioration and structural failure risk for building-stock vulnerability and demolition or renewal scenario models. Related catalogue records: Arbolado en parques y zonas verdes de Madrid (municipal tree inventory, yearly files) (data-madrid-arbolado-parques-zonas-verdes); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
